brief.t: START HERE: Call Sam and Ron to name Talova’s safety approver and confirm the authorized recovery method.

ACT NOW 1: Talova safe recovery remains unverified. Splash reported November 3, 7 days ago. Michael’s latest relevant summary has no approved safe method; trial evidence, equipment limits and suspect-unit disposition remain unverified. Send internally: Sam, Ron and Aaron, please name the approver and record the safe recovery method, trial results and suspect-unit disposition today before Michael commits staffing or completion.

ACT NOW 2: Lice Sisters preservative request needs technical correction. Evelyn’s request yesterday implies 1.0% Liquid Germall Plus: 1.2 kg in 120 kg. The named supplier publishes 0.1–0.5% suggested use. This is a potential formula/specification error, not proof material was added. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, please reconcile the exact preservative, approved formula and supplier use limits today before purchase or addition; keep the 2–3 kg buying buffer separate from batch dosage.

ACT NOW 3: Aloe and Tallow formula-label containment remains unverified. Evelyn’s discrepancy report is 6 days old. Laura’s clarification does not reconcile Rachel’s actual samples, formula, label or claims. Send internally: Sam, Evelyn, Aaron and Laura, please match Rachel’s sample formula to its label, identify affected samples and stock, and record the containment and authorized customer-response decision today.
